Subject: Vendor master activation for Redwood — onboarding packet

Hi Priya,

Thanks for the quick intro on the call earlier. We're ready to activate Clearline as a vendor in Redwood's system so we can receive POs and process invoices. To complete our vendor portal enrollment we need the following confirmed from your side: legal entity name for remittance, current ACH remit instructions (if you prefer ACH), billing address for PO/ship-to, and AP contact for invoice routing.

I've attached our onboarding packet for you to review and return: clearline_onboarding_blank.pdf (fillable). If you can send back the filled form and a bank authorization (if you accept ACH), we can turn the account on and whitelist Redwood for portal invoicing.

High-level timeline: once we have the completed packet we enable the vendor in our portal (T+1 business day) and you should receive vendor_id and upload instructions.

Attachments: clearline_onboarding_blank.pdf

Happy to take a quick screen-share if helpful.

Best,
Elena Morales

- If Clearline requires a billing address separate from a remit address, please indicate both fields on the form.
- We will upload your details into our ERP; we require either a completed W-9 (for US entities) or equivalent tax documentation for international entities.

We will return a completed vendor record confirmation and the Redwood W-9 once ERP creates the vendor. Expect a short verification call from AP if we need bank validation.
